title_sq: Shitet Super Vile 3 Kateshe Individuale Ne Mullet!!!
description_sq: Shitet Super Vile Individuale 3 Kateshe Ne Mullet!!! Vila eshte e perbere nga 3 kate dhe ka nje siperfaqe neto 231 m2, si dhe siperfaqe parcele rreth 300m2. Ne katin e pare organizohet ne nje salle te bollshme dhe nje tualet, kati i dyte perbehet nga nje holl pritje, nje sallon bashke me kuzhinen ,nje dhome gjumi dhe nje tualet me dritare, kati i trete eshte i organizuar ne 2 dhoma dhe 2 tualete ,gjithashtu ka dhe ballkon. Vila eshte totalisht e investuar: shtruar me parket cilesor, hidroizolim, termoizolim, sistem kondicionimi multi-split , dritare duplex me grile elektrike, hidrosanitare inkaso te markave me cilesore. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet vila ofron qetesine e munguar dhe ajrin e paster duke e bere ambientin me te pershtatshem per nje jetese komode dhe cilesore. Vila gjithashtu ka hapsire per parkim mbi 5 makina.
title_en: 3 Storey Super Villa for Sale in Mullet!!!
description_en: 3 Storey Individual Super Villa in Mullet for sale!!! The villa consists of 3 floors and has a net area of ​​231 m2, as well as a plot area of ​​about 300 m2. The first floor is organized in a spacious hall and a toilet, the second floor consists of a reception hall, a living room with a kitchen, a bedroom and a toilet with a window, the third floor is organized in 2 rooms and 2 toilets, it also has a balcony. The villa is fully invested: laid with quality parquet, waterproofing, thermal insulation, multi-split air conditioning system, duplex windows with electric shutters, high-quality brand-name sanitary ware. The area in which the villa is located offers the missing peace and clean air, making the environment more suitable for a comfortable and quality life. The villa also has parking space for 5 cars.
